name: Depth
long_name: seafloor depth below ocean surface at rest interpolated from the model grid
comments_1: Model seafloor depth corresponds to mean ocean depth below the geoid.
comments_2: Note: the MITgcm implements 'partial cells' so model seafloor depths differ from the seafloor depth provided by the original input bathymetry data product.

name: ice_shelf_draft
comments_1: Depth of the base of floating ice shelves and grounded ice
comments_2: Note: grounded ice can be in contact with the ocean

name: ocean_column_thickness
comments_1: Distance between the seafloor and sea surface. Ocean column thickness is equivalent to seafloor depth when the model does not have ice shelf cavities.
comments_2: Note: the MITgcm output file 'Depth.data' provides ocean column thickness. Model seafloor depth is calculated offline to account for ice shelf cavities.

name: drC
long_name: distance between the lat-lon grid cell centers in the z-direction
comments_1: The first element corresponds to the distance between the depth of the center of the uppermost model grid cell and the surface.

name: drF
long_name: distance between the top and bottom faces of the lat-lon grid cells

name: hFacC
long_name: vertical wet fraction of grid cell
comments_1: Grid cells may be fractionally closed in the vertical. The open vertical fraction is hFacC. The model allows for partially-filled cells to represent topographic variations more smoothly (hFacC < 1). Completely closed (dry) tracer grid cells have hFacC = 0.
comments_2: Note: the lat-lon gridded hFacC is spatially-averaged from the hFacC field on the lat-lon-cap (llc90) model native grid.

name: maskC
long_name: wet/dry boolean mask for grid cell
comments_1: True for wet grid cells (hFacC > 0), otherwise False.

name: cavity_mask
long_name: boolean mask indicating presence of ice-shelf cavity
comments_1: True if there is a wet grid cell (hFacC > 0) beneath a floating ice-shelf, otherwise False.
